GET /api/wallet.notes: Returns user_id, balance, free_minutes, total_recharged, total_spent

POST /api/wallet/recharge.notes: Adds balance, creates transaction, validates minimum amount

PUT /api/astrologer/profile.notes: Astrologer can update rate and profile fields

POST /api/consultation/start.notes: Starts call, creates 100ms room, returns tokens

POST /api/consultation/{call_id}/process.notes: Processes billing, deducts free mins or wallet

GET /api/consultation/history.notes: Returns call history with duration, charges
